reasons.ADMISSION_ASSUMED: For the demo, every pending student trip was counted as confirmed. This is an assumption, not a real confirmation.
reasons.ASSIGNMENT_SEARCH_INDETERMINATE: The vehicle assignment search hit its limit. The vehicle count shown is an upper bound; fewer may be possible.
reasons.CERTIFICATE_INVALID: The solver's feasibility certificate is not valid; the route was not trusted.
reasons.CLOSING_DEPOT_ARC_MISSING: A route does not end with a return to campus; the route was rejected.
reasons.DUPLICATE_MATRIX_ARC: The travel-time matrix has conflicting durations for the same arc.
reasons.DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE_COVERAGE: The same trip appears in more than one route; the plan was rejected.
reasons.FLEET_INVALID: Vehicle records contain invalid or duplicate data.
reasons.FLEET_SHORTAGE: Current fleet cannot be assigned to these routes. This does not prove that other routes are impossible or establish an exact extra vehicle count.
reasons.JOB_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: A wave has an inconsistent time or direction; the plan was rejected.
reasons.LEG_DECISIONS_UNAVAILABLE: The student decision table was not found; recorded confirmations could not be read.
reasons.LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS_CONFIRMATION: Some students have legacy requests and their confirmation state is ambiguous.
reasons.MATRIX_ARC_MISMATCH: A duration in a route does not match the travel-time matrix.
reasons.MATRIX_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The travel-time matrix is invalid or corrupt.
reasons.MATRIX_UNAVAILABLE: The travel-time matrix could not be loaded or is incomplete; routes could not be computed.
reasons.MISSING_OCCURRENCE_COVERAGE: Some trips were not placed in any route; the plan was rejected.
reasons.NO_ADMITTED_DEMAND: There are no confirmed trips for this day.
reasons.NO_ROUTE_STEPS: A route has no steps; the plan was rejected.
reasons.OPTIMIZATION_NOT_SUCCESSFUL: The route solver did not return a successful result or could not be reached.
reasons.PENDING_STUDENT_CONFIRMATION: Some student confirmations are still pending.
reasons.RIDE_TIME_LIMIT_INFEASIBLE: No suitable route was computed within the chosen student ride limit ({limit} min). This result does not prove that no route is possible at this limit.
reasons.ROUTE_OUTSIDE_SERVICE_DAY: A route runs outside the service day.
reasons.ROUTE_LOAD_MISMATCH: The Sw/So counts of a route do not match its student list.
reasons.ROUTE_TOTAL_MISMATCH: A route's total duration does not match the sum of its steps.
reasons.SCHEDULE_DATA_INVALID: Schedule or student record data is invalid.
reasons.UNKNOWN_OCCURRENCE: A route refers to a trip that is not in this plan.
reasons.UNKNOWN_ROUTE_NODE: A route contains an unrecognised stop.
reasons.unknown: Unknown status code. Report it to the technical team.

limits.title: Known limitations
limits.notOptimal: The solver is not optimal; the route count is not a true minimum (only the vehicle assignment is proven).
limits.fixedRoutes: The vehicle count applies only to these fixed routes.
limits.timeModel: The time model is simple: each wave is tied to a single arrival/departure time (use_time_windows: false). Waiting and return-to-campus checks are not made (H2, H4).
limits.noNames: No student names are shown; location codes (like So1, Sw3) are used.
